# Legacy HexStrike — migrated to veneno

HexStrike lineage and the engage execution layer moved to **[veneno](https://github.com/butbeautifulv/veneno)**.

Veil retains only the **ingest bridge**: `pipeline/engage-events/`, `pkg/engage/events/`, `GET /v1/categories/engage/context`.

See [veil-veneno-split.md](../architecture/veil-veneno-split.md).
